register_coco_instances: register a COCO-format instance detection or segmentation dataset with name, metadata, image root, and annotation JSON path
register_coco_panoptic_separated: register a COCO-format panoptic segmentation dataset with separated instance and semantic annotations
load_coco_json: load a COCO-format JSON annotation file and return a list of Detectron2 standard dataset dicts
convert_to_coco_json: convert a Detectron2-format dataset dict list to COCO-format JSON annotation file
test_coco_dataset_loader: test the COCO JSON dataset loader by running the module CLI with json path, image root, and dataset name arguments
